scene_ro6_end1_enter.title: 好奇心与死
scene_ro6_end1_enter.description: “我一直在等你。”一只猫？你并不确定它究竟是什么。“但你不太走运。在黑流树海之中，距离和方向并没有实质意义。”你伸出手去触碰，却发现周围的一切事物都变成了虚幻的立体投影。

scene_ro6_end1_1.title: 好奇心与死
scene_ro6_end1_1.description: 你用手头的物资与这里的电源临时搭建起一个信号发射器，新的坐标在你的终端上浮现。与此同时，这处据点的机器和那只猫的投影都消失了，像是从不曾存在过一般。

scene_ro6_end1_2.title: 好奇心与死
scene_ro6_end1_2.description: 是那只猫的源石技艺吗？你想要弄个明白，但在你走上前快要抓住它的瞬间，周围的一切都骤然消失了，只剩下一个闪闪发光的物件掉在你的脚边。

scene_ro6_end2_enter.title: 窥视箱中
scene_ro6_end2_enter.description: “我一直在等你。”一只......猫？你并不确定她究竟是什么。“不明白也没有关系。我向正在观察我们之人言说，尽管我不知道你是否拥有生命和意识。我邀请你见证必将发生之事。”

scene_ro6_end2_1.title: 窥视箱中
scene_ro6_end2_1.description: “你不是来找我的？好吧。”她转过身去，没有回头再对你说什么，环境中只剩下机器持续运作的轻微噪音。为了避免再生事端，你决定离开这个可疑的地方。

scene_ro6_end2_2.title: 窥视箱中
scene_ro6_end2_2.description: “你对它们的用途有一些猜测，对吗？”她对你露出了笑容，“不必紧张，它们并不会以你想象的方式运作。但即便我这么说，你仍会尝试阻止我，你也必须这么做。”

rules: Ordinary floor V has three visually indistinguishable fate nodes: two false 好奇心与死 and one true 窥视箱中, after applying the account/route gate.
At false fate choose exactly one: pay 50 coins to mark the true location, or receive one collectible.
The mark is a FEATURE mechanic, not a collectible, movement, or additional reward.
The paid marking option is unavailable when the true location is already marked. Holding both sandboxes marks the true fate.
False fate has one settlement per node. Its other same-named node remains independently available.
True fate protect-evidence changes that same node into the ro6_b_5 boss. Leaving true fate activates its marker feature chain.
The one-relic false-fate reward has no rarity qualifier in the client. Observed draws include NORMAL, RARE and SUPER_RARE.
Second-ending fate route requires first-ending completion and at least one of the two sandbox relics. Full technology is not the unlock.
Leaving the true fate completes but preserves a repeatable marked STORY node; reentry is permitted.
Protect-evidence commits to the boss; departure is unavailable after node conversion. The subsequent client ZONE_END choice starts the current-region boss.
The converted true-fate boss does not activate battle-node arrival concepts. The player arrived at a STORY node, not at a newly moved-to battle node.
Completing the floor-V second-ending boss while holding the beacon continues into floor VI. The second and third route map flags are therefore compatible.
unverified: Server weights for true-fate position and reward identity.
Exact false-node icon/type after settlement; the current simulator uses its general completed-node empty convention.
Account unlock gate must be supplied separately; full technology alone is not proof of second-ending availability.
